name: GakuPara!! ~Gakuen Paradise!!~
source: Inoue Seiji was experimented on by his friend Momiji, and now his bodily fluids act as a love potion. He attracts females just by sneezing or sweating. Because of the experiment, Momiji was kicked out of science club. If he wants to return to his normal self, they need to recruit five people to form another club.
